Uttarakhand Police Arrest Gym Owner Mohammad Deepak Amid Assault Allegations

Uttarakhand Police arrested gym owner Mohammad Deepak on October 1 in Kotdwar following allegations of threats and assault by a businessman. Police stated the arrest was a preventive measure to avoid a breach of peace. The incident involves Mohammad Deepak, who had previously been a subject of national discussion after confronting protesters regarding a Muslim shopkeeper's business name. The businessman who made the allegations is a saree shop owner.
